title: RWB-S6-E6004-APP: the take-bids slice has no plan row for its five consumed contracts, its guard and outbox libraries, the publish-first story of API-S6-005, the bid and realised-recovery columns, the two rules it shares with sibling keys, the reporting destination of R-DS-34, its wave or its requirement id
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R5.6, R7.3 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S6-E6004-APP; context pack S6 rwb-debtsale (service row, ownership rows, Architecture v5 slides 3, 4, 5, 8 and 13); legacy RWB-E6-004; FSD S6 Debt sale v3 A2.8.1 to A2.8.4 and Requirements served; TSD S6 Debt sale v2 T2, T3.1 to T3.3, T4, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1, T6.2, T-A.1 and T-A.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-17, R-DS-18, R-DS-34, R-DS-35 and R-DS-39; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-DBS-08
description: (1) The plan gives H = RWB-S6-E6004-CON, RWB-PLT-E1027-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON with C, I and X empty, while the step reads the rwb-partner clearance facts, the rwb-case case state, the rwb-access right and the rwb-decision package and answers the rwb-case case move, so five consumed rows have no plan row. (2) DP-08 is absent although the provided operation declares a capability area and a right, and DP-09 is absent although the service owns topic rwb.debtsale.events.v1, so RWB-PLT-TE006-CON is absent from the H row. (3) The legacy story lists the award path API-S6-003 and the data room read API-S6-004 as its endpoints; TSD S6 T-A.1 gives the bid submission API-S6-005 'first in E5', the data room story names the bid as a later story's, and the award story names API-S6-005 as the data room story's, so the publishing story of the operation is not fixed by any source. (4) TSD S6 T3.1 declares no bid amount, bid time or bid reference on debt_sale_lot or debt_sale_account and no realised-recovery column beyond selling_price. (5) R-DS-18 is named by legacy RWB-E6-002 AC3 and R-DS-34 by legacy RWB-E6-009 AC3, and the split stories of those keys declare both rules as well. (6) R-DS-34 names 'Recovery Data Store, Power BI' and a 'per claim window' timer; there is no data lake, no catalogue event carries a lot closure and no source gives the claim window a length. (7) The story wave is EP06 wave 4 while rwb-debtsale is created in wave 3. (8) No programme requirement row covers taking the bid. (9) The legacy Data table names recovery_case, decision_log_entry and rule_row, which this service may not read or write, and the legacy endpoints carry the monolith base. (10) The partner channel that delivers the bid has no story row.
evidence: split plan slice RWB-S6-E6004-APP with three H rows and empty C, I and X; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-08, DP-09 and DP-17 rows and R5.6 wave map; context pack ownership rows (debt_sale_lot and debt_sale_account, five REST operations, event EV-23, workflow DebtSaleWorkflow); TSD S6 T-A.1 first-epic column and T-A.2 BidRequest and Bid; TSD S6 T3.1 field list; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-17, R-DS-18, R-DS-34, R-DS-35 and R-DS-39; FSD S6 A2.8.3.1 and A2.8.4.4; sibling story files RWB-S6-E6002-APP, RWB-S6-E6009-APP and RWB-S6-E5026-CON; legacy RWB-E6-004 Data, Endpoints, Test cases and Guardrails
area: Dependency, ownership, rule and data model
proposed: Keep the plan's H, C, I and X rows as they stand and record the five consumed rows as class C in fact with placeholders; record RWB-PLT-TE006-CON as the wave 0 library the service topic needs and state the DP-08 guard as a service-template capability; fix API-S6-005 as this key's operation because it is the take-bids deliverable and the other stories declare it as not built by them; hold the bid amount, time and reference in the decision record and the idempotency row until the column set is added; fix one writer per rule (R-DS-18 here, R-DS-34's claim branch in RWB-S6-E6009-APP) at assembly; replace the Power BI and data-lake destination with the rwb-reporting read model and record that no event carries the closure; keep wave 4 and allocate one requirement id in the PRD

title: RWB-S6-E6004-CON: the bid operation has no field-level baseline, the consumed operation names are unpublished, the publish-first story of API-S6-005 is contested, the bid fact has no column set and the step has no event, Schedule or requirement row
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R5.7, R7.2 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S6-E6004-CON; context pack S6 rwb-debtsale; legacy RWB-E6-004; FSD S6 Debt sale v3 A2.8.2 to A2.8.4 and Screens; TSD S6 Debt sale v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1, T-A.1 and T-A.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-17, R-DS-18, R-DS-34, R-DS-35 and R-DS-39
description: (1) TSD S6 T-A.2 gives API-S6-005 only a purpose, the Request BidRequest, the Response Bid and the status-code error list; it publishes no field, no required flag, no example and no message id per condition, so the element names and the error binding are fixed by this baseline. (2) The rwb-partner clearance read, the rwb-case case-move answer and the rwb-access authorise call have no published operation name. (3) TSD S6 T-A.1 gives API-S6-005 'first in E5' while RWB-S6-E5026-CON, RWB-S6-E6005-APP and RWB-S6-E6009-APP each name the bid as another story's surface, so the publishing story is not fixed. (4) The Bid element declares an amount, a time and a reference that neither table of TSD S6 T3.1 carries. (5) TSD S6 T5.3 declares only LotAwarded for the module, so no event shape exists for a bid or a lot closure. (6) R-DS-18 and R-DS-34 are declared by the sibling keys as well, so one answer shape has two declared holders. (7) The claim window has no length in any source, and R-DS-34 declares a 'per claim window' timer with no Schedule. (8) No programme requirement row covers the step. (9) The plan's C, I and X rows of this slice are empty while the contract declares five consumed rows.
evidence: TSD S6 T-A.1 operation inventory and first-epic column; TSD S6 T-A.2 endpoint detail for API-S6-005 with the error list 401, 403, 404, 409, 422 and 503 and no message id; TSD S6 T3.1 and T3.2; TSD S6 T5.3 (LotAwarded only); Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-17 to R-DS-39; sibling story files RWB-S6-E5026-CON, RWB-S6-E6002-CON and RWB-S6-E6009-CON; legacy RWB-E6-004 messages MSG-S6-001, MSG-GEN-001, MSG-P4-002 and MSG-P7-003
area: Contract surface, storage and event set
proposed: Publish the baseline with the placeholders, bind every error condition to one message id of section 14, declare the Bid element with the storage split of the amount, time and reference into the decision record, confirm the three operation names and the publish-first question with their owners before the tag, and record the tag date in the contract README
